```{r}
cell_id_one <- "CX1"
cell_id_two <- "CX2"
treated_one <- TRUE
treated_two <- FALSE
num_cells_before_one <- 5415
num_cells_before_two <- 8123
num_cells_after_one <- 1432
num_cells_after_two <- 7543
```
```{r}
cell_id_vec <- c(cell_id_one, cell_id_two)
treated_vec <- c(treated_one, treated_two)
num_cells_before_vec <- c(num_cells_before_one, num_cells_before_two)
num_cells_after_vec <- c(num_cells_after_one, num_cells_after_two)
```

```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  cell_id = c(cell_id_one, cell_id_two),
  treated = c(treated_one,treated_two),
  num_cells_before = c(num_cells_before_one, num_cells_before_two),
  num_cells_after = c(num_cells_after_one, num_cells_after_two)
)
gt(my_data_frame)
```
